verdict.rationale: Docs confirm domestic wires (with status tracking) and FedNow (instant settlement, 24/7/365) as documented rails, but there is no evidence of RTP support anywhere in the pack, and the FedNow docs don't explicitly distinguish origination vs. receipt capability. missing for 10: explicit RTP origination/receipt documentation, per-rail origination vs receipt distinction for FedNow, any FedNow/RTP-specific API reference beyond marketing-style copy.
